instruction.text: Read the sentence and select the singular possessive noun(s).

hint.text: Possessive nouns show that someone or something owns something.

atoms.b: Ursula met up with her ((sister’s)) friend to plan a surprise birthday party.

instruction.text: Write the correct possessive in the gap using the word in brackets.

atoms.b: I went to my ((uncle’s)) [uncle] record store after school.
atoms.sound: I went to my uncle’s record shop after school.

atoms.b: The glitter from ((Joe’s)) [Joe] dress got everywhere on the floor.
atoms.sound: The glitter from Joe’s dress got everywhere on the floor.

wrong.text: Be careful with correct capitalisation. Joe is a proper noun.

atoms.b: My ((plant’s)) [plant] leaves began to turn yellow and droop.
atoms.sound: My plant’s leaves began to turn yellow and droop.

atoms.b: Out of all the crumbles in the world, my ((grandfather’s)) [grandfather] is the best.
atoms.sound: Out of all the crumbles in the world, my grandfather’s is the best.

atoms.b: ((Clara’s)) [Clara] older sister has the best music taste.
atoms.sound: Clara’s older sister has the best music taste.

wrong.text: Be careful with correct capitalisation. Clara is a proper noun, and it’s at the beginning of the sentence.
wrong.sound: ssml: Be careful with correct capitalisation. Clara is a proper noun, <prosody rate = '50%'>and</prosody> it’s at the beginning of the sentence.

instruction.text: Choose the correct possessive form in the following examples.

atoms.b: The cinema((++’s s s’)) toilets were sparkling clean.
atoms.sound: The cinema’s toilets were sparkling clean.

atoms.b: Our dog((++s’ s 's)) fur gets extremely dirty when it’s raining outside.
atoms.sound: Our dogs'fur gets extremely dirty when it’s raining outside.

instruction.text: Select the correctly rewritten phrases using a possessive noun.

atoms.a: the high notes of the singer
